sections.Profile:
The "Starlite" pinball machine, released by Williams Manufacturing Company in March 1953, is a single-player, electro-mechanical game designed by Harry Williams and Sam Stern, with artwork by George Molentin.

- Manufacturer: Williams Electronic Games Inc.
- Years made: 1953
- In production: no
- Type: Electro-Mechanical
- Display: Lights
- Players: 1
- Tags: Single Player, Wood Rail, Circus, Original Theme, Animals
